gold_sql: SELECT a.name AS account, SUM(j.credit - j.debit) AS revenue FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id = j.account_id WHERE a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_REVENUE', 'NON_OPERATING_REVENUE') AND j.post_date = '2026-06-09' GROUP BY a.name
